Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Geometric Wool Runner Rug, 2' 6" x 8', Ivory, Red, Purple
Colors: Ivory, Red, Purple
Materials: wool
Red and purple geometrics on ivory combine influences of Southwestern and modern, providing an eye-catching centerpiece for your hallway. The hand-tufted wool blend is soft, while the pile height makes it easy to maintain and slide under furniture. 2' 6" x 8' with medium 0.3" pile Easy to maintain and fits well under furniture Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
